# Team Commit Template

Use this template for all commits. Keep each commit focused on one work unit.

<type>(<scope>): <imperative subject>

- Explain the behavior/outcome introduced or fixed.
- Capture key implementation decisions and constraints.
- Note verification done (tests, lint, type-check, manual checks).

Refs: <issue/PR link, optional>

<!--
Types:  feat · fix · docs · style · refactor · perf · test · chore · ci
Scopes: app · core · api · auth · i18n · ui · deps · config (adapt per module)
